supplementalSources.title: Feedback on obby UI
supplementalSources.author: CSJeverything
supplementalSources.observation: Persistent actions stay on the screen edges while larger menu and admin surfaces use a separate centered panel hierarchy.

supplementalSources.title: Roleplay Admin panel feedback
supplementalSources.author: Pxtiichor
supplementalSources.observation: Administrative roleplay surfaces need compact grouping and centered action placement; oversized empty panels read as unfinished.

supplementalSources.title: Map selector as well as stats and levels
supplementalSources.author: OnceWasGrand
supplementalSources.observation: Roleplay navigation combines map selection with progression data so jobs, politics, crime, and emergency-role loops remain discoverable.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback Needed for TD Game UI
supplementalSources.author: devvres
supplementalSources.observation: Wave progression is a persistent gameplay instrument whose contrast stays below the primary interface while remaining readable at a glance.

supplementalSources.title: Anime Design UI Feedback
supplementalSources.author: 94Hrz
supplementalSources.observation: Anime progression surfaces use strong outline hierarchy and saturated accent families, while feedback identifies over-brightness as a readability risk.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on Game UI
supplementalSources.author: PandaPb
supplementalSources.observation: Health-style bars become more legible when their edges and value hierarchy are explicit instead of relying on flat color alone.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on my Pet simulator 99 inspired UI
supplementalSources.author: Astrozto
supplementalSources.observation: Trading gives each player's offer a bounded region and needs explicit search affordance; an unlabeled field was mistaken for unused space.

supplementalSources.title: Pet Simulator 99 UI practice
supplementalSources.author: Astrozto
supplementalSources.observation: Dense pet icon grids remain scannable when padding is preserved and the surrounding panel uses subdued texture instead of competing decoration.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on Pets Ui
supplementalSources.author: Gamemaster712Z
supplementalSources.observation: Pet inventory polish depends on consistent corner radii, title clearance, close-button placement, and enough background treatment.

supplementalSources.title: Pets UI Feedback Wanted
supplementalSources.author: DaffyDavinko
supplementalSources.observation: The pet grid needs equal outer padding, coherent border treatment, and enough color and texture contrast to distinguish slots from the container.

supplementalSources.title: Pet inventory and upgrades UI
supplementalSources.author: Rapture_TY
supplementalSources.observation: Pet inventory and upgrade screens share thick display typography and outlined cards; consistent outline weight and font scale keep the family coherent.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on Minimal UI
supplementalSources.author: epochzx
supplementalSources.observation: Minimal surfaces rely on shape, spacing, and motion more than decorative texture; dark mode changes typography and close-button treatment as one system.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on Minimal UI Set
supplementalSources.author: epochzx
supplementalSources.observation: A restrained surface palette, wide whitespace, and consistent corner geometry carry the family across light and dark variants.

supplementalSources.title: Menu UI Feedback
supplementalSources.author: Archasion
supplementalSources.observation: The sparse layout survives several accent colors because hierarchy comes from placement, scale, and whitespace rather than color-specific decoration.

supplementalSources.title: Clean modern UI attempt
supplementalSources.author: Danielhoteaale
supplementalSources.observation: Clean modern UI improves materially when alignment and background texture strength are tuned after the first visual pass.

supplementalSources.title: RPG Game GUI feedback
supplementalSources.author: ilm2art
supplementalSources.observation: RPG health, mana, parry, and level information benefits from thematic bars and sufficient contrast against the environment.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback for RPG UI
supplementalSources.author: i_Rook
supplementalSources.observation: A clean dark field with restrained illustrated accents and centered labels lets typography and framing carry the RPG theme.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on RPG battle visuals
supplementalSources.author: judash399
supplementalSources.observation: Combat UI improves when edge padding is deliberate and health and selection elements stay readable against a changing battle scene.

supplementalSources.title: Classic 2012-inspired game UI
supplementalSources.author: XxKawaiiGore
supplementalSources.observation: Classic fidelity comes from sparse chrome, compact top-level controls, and period proportions rather than modern rounded-card conventions.

supplementalSources.title: 2011 and 2012 revival UI
supplementalSources.author: XxKawaiiGore
supplementalSources.observation: Era-specific side borders, flatter controls, and denser chrome distinguish the 2011 and 2012 family from contemporary card-based Roblox UI.

supplementalSources.title: oldBLOX menu design
supplementalSources.author: TyDye8
supplementalSources.observation: Retro menus retain period character while adding enough text margin and information grouping to remain usable on modern resolutions.

supplementalSources.title: Classic CoreGui references
supplementalSources.author: Macintozh
supplementalSources.observation: The classic family is defined by CoreGui-era structures such as the player list and toolbar, stronger anchors than generic nostalgia colors.

supplementalSources.title: Classic Battles kit menu
supplementalSources.author: NetheriteMc_Q
supplementalSources.observation: Classic Roblox visual language still needs clear card separation, contrast, and responsive scaling; period styling does not excuse unreadable grouping.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on our farming game
supplementalSources.author: Wizzardofaz
supplementalSources.observation: Farm layout and UI should make the harvest-to-market loop spatially obvious; travel distance and destination value are visual information architecture.

supplementalSources.title: Working on a Farm Life Sim
supplementalSources.author: DevForum creator
supplementalSources.observation: A cozy farm-life interface benefits from compact top-level information and contextual radial interaction instead of permanent action chrome.

supplementalSources.title: Blocky Farming Devlog
supplementalSources.author: DevForum creator
supplementalSources.observation: Farming feedback works when held tools visibly match the current action and the interface reinforces the same planting or watering state change.

supplementalSources.title: Boredom Farming feedback
supplementalSources.author: mekboy21
supplementalSources.observation: Placement and shop rows need labels and tighter image-to-item association so build-mode choices can be understood without trial and error.

supplementalSources.title: Feedback on Farming World
supplementalSources.author: SolsticeDevs
supplementalSources.observation: A farming UI must retain the same interaction affordances on console; broken increment buttons are a visual and interaction failure.

supplementalSources.title: UI on phone looks horrible
supplementalSources.author: Virvek
supplementalSources.observation: Stroke thickness and spacing that look balanced on desktop can dominate a phone viewport; mobile-first styling must scale decoration as well as layout.

supplementalSources.title: UI looks different on mobile
supplementalSources.author: Ku_Sas
supplementalSources.observation: Aspect constraints alone do not produce a usable mobile composition; child sizes and positions need a coherent scale strategy at the target aspect.

supplementalSources.title: Mobile Notched Screen
supplementalSources.author: greenworx
supplementalSources.observation: Edge-to-edge UI must make an explicit safe-area decision; copying desktop margins to notched phones changes the composition substantially.

supplementalSources.title: Gamepad UI Highlight Improvements
supplementalSources.author: AykeriZero
supplementalSources.observation: Controller-first UI needs an unmistakable selected state and a spatial button layout whose directional navigation matches what the player sees.
